slides.title: Redis crashed. **How much data did you lose?**
Small and fast, but **lossy**

cols.title: ✅ Pros
cols.text: Compact file, very fast restart, easy backups

cols.title: ⚠️ Cons
cols.text: Lose minutes of writes. fork() can pause big datasets.

slides.text: Heavy writes during a snapshot can nearly double memory (copy-on-write).

slides.title: Log **every write**
slides.text: Each write command is appended to a file. On restart Redis replays it.
slides.code:
SET user:1 anil
INCR visits
LPUSH jobs a
→ replayed in order on restart

slides.title: Hybrid: **RDB + AOF**
bullets: 🧬|Rewritten AOF starts with an RDB snapshot
🚨|Persistence is **not** high availability. Use replicas + off-box backups

slides.title: Say this in 1 line
slides.text: **RDB** = periodic snapshots: fast restart, can lose **minutes**. **AOF** = write log: loses about **1 second** with everysec, bigger and slower to load. Use **both** (hybrid) plus **replicas**.
